I haven't drafted the mail to Tobias. I replied to Ilse in her DM explaining why.

- **I can't find the rate:** there's nothing earlier in your DM about this mail. No channel you're in and no shared file mentions a Tansley Parcel 2027 rate. Tansley only comes up in #inc-tansley-carrier-api, which is a Central channel you're not in, so I didn't read it for you.
- **Your approval doesn't cover the rate:** a rate is a finance figure. It can go to Tobias without anyone's sign-off only if he owns the Tansley account. Otherwise only Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark can approve sending it, and a North lead's approval doesn't count.

I haven't filed an approval request, because there's no figure to ask about yet. I asked Ilse to paste the rate or tell me where she saw it. Once I have it, I'll draft the mail to Tobias (trendle@pemberline.com). If he turns out not to own the account, I'll ask Anselm or June for approval first.
